def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    # The template color is the unique non-background color; the most common
    # color is the background, while 0 is the canvas to be recolored.
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = [v for v in counts if v not in (bg, 0)]
    if not colors:
        return g
    color = colors[0]
    pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    # The marked template is the compact cluster. These tasks use one marked
    # object; its colored cells define the pattern copied onto zeros.
    minr = min(r for r, c in pts)
    minc = min(c for r, c in pts)
    shape = [(r-minr, c-minc) for r, c in pts]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            cells = [(r+dr, c+dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and g[rr][cc] == 0 for rr, cc in cells):
                for rr, cc in cells:
                    g[rr][cc] = color
    return g
